summary_en: Annual dividend raised to 55 yen from previous guidance, including 3 yen interim dividend and 52 yen year-end dividend. Earnings revised upward with operating profit guidance increased to 330.0 billion yen on stronger rental office business performance.
title_en: Notice regarding upward revision of full-year earnings forecast, implementation of interim dividend, and revision of year-end dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief:
Sumitomo Realty & Development raised its annual dividend to 55 yen per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, comprising a 3 yen interim dividend and a revised 52 yen year-end dividend. This represents an increase from the previous year-end guidance of 52 yen and reflects a shift in dividend policy to allocate approximately 60% of earnings growth to dividend increases, up from the previous 35% target.

The dividend increase was prompted by stronger-than-expected performance in the rental office business, driven by tight supply-demand conditions and rising rents in Tokyo's central business district. The company also revised its full-year earnings upward: operating profit now forecast at 330.0 billion yen (up 10.0 billion yen), recurring profit at 315.0 billion yen (up 15.0 billion yen), and net income attributable to parent at 230.0 billion yen (up 7.0 billion yen).

Management indicated that as cash flow is expected to increase further from expanded rental revenues and equity sales, it intends to accelerate dividend growth under the new framework. The company aims to double its annual dividend to 100 yen within five years while maintaining steady earnings growth through optimizing its asset portfolio.
